note: Large wooded Ozark area south of Highway 17 west of Summersville, with shooting and archery ranges and 12 miles of hiking, biking and horse trails. The map marks three primitive camping spots, each by a gravel lot: this pin is the north one on Tower Drive near the Highway 17 entrance; the other two are on Ranch Road in the south, reached from Route W. --Claude
summary: Confirmed: page 'Camping: Designated Camping Sites; Individual Campsites', 'primitive camping areas'; map (6/11/2020) three Primitive Camping symbols, each beside a lot = GIS 144-146. No horse camp: horses use roads/trails and no camp is marked for them. Free/FCFS/no hookups/14 nights manual. PIN (GIS 146) in woods ~55 m W of lot 762: move onto the lot 37.21059,-91.76402. No split (Ranch Rd candidates named). Phone mismatch: page (417) 256-7161 vs stored 573-368-2225.
flags: INCLUSION/FIT: area page 'Camping: Designated Camping Sites; Individual Campsites'; 'Other features and facilities here include: rifle, pistol, and shotgun shooting range, primitive camping areas, walk through archery range, fishing ponds, and 12 miles of hiking/biking/equestrian trails'; 'Designated camping areas may or may not have defined campsites.' Map (6/11/2020) legend 'Primitive Camping'; three symbols, each beside a Parking Lot = GIS 146 (north, Tower Dr), 144 (Ranch Rd east) and 145 (Ranch Rd west). Imagery: lot 762 is a gravel turnaround ~25 m across with a short loop spur north of it; lot 763 a small gravel pad with a loop spur; lot 764 a gravel lot ~40 x 25 m at a trail crossing. A 23-ft rig fits each. Designated points beside lots, none a ramp lot: stays.

HORSE CAMP: none. The page: 'Equestrian use is allowed on roads open to vehicular traffic'; 'Horses must stay on roads open to vehicular traffic or on multi-use trails posted as open to horses.' The map marks no equestrian camp; the Ranch Rd lots double as trailheads for the hiking/biking/equestrian trail, so horse trailers may share them, but the camps are general primitive camps.
PIN: stored 37.21082,-91.76456 = GIS 146, in woods ~55 m west of lot 762. Move onto the lot: 37.21059,-91.76402.

CLUSTERS / NO SPLIT: north camp 146 (Tower Dr, entrance from Highway 17 by Gist Ranch Rd; the shooting ranges are at that entrance ~1.1 km NE); south camps 144 (37.16967,-91.76910, 4.6 km S) and 145 (37.16911,-91.80524, 5.9 km SW), 3.2 km apart on Ranch Rd, entrance from Route W. The Ranch Rd pair has its own road and entrance, but each camp is a single small trailhead lot, so no split is proposed (Fox Valley rule). If AWH wants one, the candidate is 'Gist Ranch Conservation Area (Ranch Road)' at lot 763 37.16937,-91.76852; near.py: nothing else in campgrounds.json within 3 km of either south camp.
WATERFRONT (not waterfront, kept): the north camp is ~100 m from a small fishing pond (under 5 acres = pond); the Ranch Rd camps have no water near.
PHONE MISMATCH: area page 'For more information call (417) 256-7161'; stored 573-368-2225 is not on the page.
Season (manual, year-round) left as stored; page 'Seasonal closures and restrictions may apply to all camping on department areas'.
